C++ — Quoted

Intrinsic calibration, intrinsic-parameter writing, and factory-intrinsic restoration are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Write operations use a complete CameraParametersConfig.

Correspond calibration.cpp . The results are structured using SDK Defined nlohmann::json Type alias.

API Reference

identifyBoard(ip, resultJson)

Purpose: Triggers the photograph and identifies the type of inner-referenced panel, while returning to the test preview to confirm the plate type and visibility.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

resultJson

IntrinsicIdentifyBoardResult &

Value of resultJson.

Returns: Return when successful in obtaining and parsing results true.

checkIntrinsicAccuracy(ip, resultJson)

Purpose: Perform an independent internal cucuracy check, including plate position, single camera re-projection error and stereo alignment error calculation; read overtime 120 seconds, do not add an image to the marked session.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

resultJson

IntrinsicAccuracyCheckResult &

Value of resultJson.

Returns: Return when successful in obtaining and parsing results true.

addCalibImage(ip, boardType, resultJson)

Purpose: Collects a group of maps in the identified plate type and adds the camera’s current internal reference session.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

boardType

int

Calibration board type.

resultJson

IntrinsicAddCalibImageResult &

Value of resultJson.

Returns: Successfully added graph-to-map return true.

removeCalibImage(ip, pairIndex, resultJson)

Purpose: Removes the specified map pairs from the current marked session and applies to removing the mask, blur or error pattern samples.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

pairIndex

int

Calibration image-pair index.

resultJson

IntrinsicRemoveCalibImageResult &

Value of resultJson.

Returns: Successfully remove graphs back on time true.

calculate(ip, resultJson)

Purpose: Use all the charts left in the current session to calculate internal and external references and return the complete configuration that you can write to the camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

resultJson

IntrinsicCalculateResult &

Value of resultJson.

Returns: Returns when calculated and parsed successfully true. == Mark Process

identifyBoard → Operators confirm step by step addCalibImage → Clear invalid image pair → Operator confirm. calculate → Operator confirm. setCameraIntrinsicParameters

The board should cover the location, distance and attitude of the field of view. detectSuccess, pairIndex, plate position, tilt and preview information; the image of the failed test must be used immediately pairIndex Call removeCalibImage, the test is successful but the preview is not satisfactory. The image should also be deleted and re-recorded.

The operator can continue to collect or call the valid graphs retained after reaching the set number calculate. After confirming that the error is normal, the error will resultJson["cameraParametersConfig"] Convert to CameraParametersConfig; only when the operator has finally confirmed it will it be sent to setCameraIntrinsicParameters.shouldWarnRms=true, complete configuration is missing, exit or end of input.

Multi-Image Source Type

All units pass once. calculate Return full cameraParametersConfig.BinoWithColor Configuration of the aircraft type contains depthSrc1, depthSrc2 and textureSrc; cameraParameters, colorCameraParameters and corresponding error fields to check the calculation details. Use when writing a camera cameraParametersConfig.

Interactive Example

./build/examples/IntrinsicCalibration/IntrinsicCalibration 10.10.11.33 4

The second parameter is the minimum valid graph logarithm required to allow the calculation, with the minimum value being 4; third parameter optional to specify known board_type. The console is used C Collection, collection`K` Retention or calculation,R Delete Replay,W Final confirmation for writing,B Back to collect,Q Safe exit. The image of the failed test will be automatically deleted; the process will be aborted when the failure is deleted, avoiding the use of data sets containing invalid samples.

Example: Write after confirmation

TFTech::IntrinsicCalculateResult result;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::calculate(ip, result)) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Inline calculation failed");
}

std::cout << "Depth Double-eye RMS: " << result["stereoRms"] << '\n';
if (!result["colorStereoRms"].is_null()) {
    std::cout << "Main Depth Camera-Colour Camera RMS: " << result["colorStereoRms"] << '\n';
}
if (result["shouldWarnRms"].get<bool>()) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Mark RMS Beyond security threshold, not written to camera");
}
auto cameraParametersConfig = result["cameraParametersConfig"].get<TFTech::CameraParametersConfig>();
std::cout << "Confirm to write the full configuration above to the camera? W Write, other inputs cancel:";
std::string choice;
std::getline(std::cin, choice);
if (choice != "W" && choice != "w") {
    std::cout << "Canceled, not written on camera\n";
    return;
}
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::setCameraIntrinsicParameters(ip, cameraParametersConfig)) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Full reference configuration writing failed");
}

Example: Inline precision check

TFTech::IntrinsicAccuracyCheckResult result;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::checkIntrinsicAccuracy(ip, result)) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Inline precision check failed");
}

std::cout << result.dump(2) << '\n';
